# Filecoin Data Portal

> Open Filecoin datasets, published as Parquet files and rebuilt daily.

Read the agent instructions before answering data questions.

## Agents

- [SKILL.md](/SKILL.md): How to choose, query, and interpret datasets.
- [Markdown catalog](/datasets.md): Every dataset, linking a Markdown page per dataset at `/datasets/<dataset>.md` with columns, units, coverage, and sources.

## Site

- [Datasets](/datasets): Searchable catalog with schemas, samples, and downloads.
- [Numbers](/numbers): Sourced charts and the full metric ledger.
- [Docs](/docs): Query examples and caveats.
- [About](/about): Maintainer, funding, licensing, and the previous site.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/davidgasquez/filecoin-data-portal): Pipelines, models, tests, and website.
- [Data sources](https://github.com/davidgasquez/filecoin-data-portal/blob/main/docs/data-sources.md): Upstream APIs, indexers, and RPC endpoints.
- [Report an issue](https://github.com/davidgasquez/filecoin-data-portal/issues/new): Incorrect, unclear, stale, or missing data.
